description: Fall onto outstretched left hand
Booked in at ED reception
Nurse triage, first observations and pain score
IV paracetamol and oral morphine given
Assessed by ED doctor; wrist immobilised in temporary splint
Bloods taken: FBC, U&E, bone profile, coagulation, group and save
AP and lateral radiographs of the wrist
Report issued for pre-reduction radiographs
Haematoma block and manipulation; backslab applied
Post-reduction radiographs in plaster
Report issued for post-reduction radiographs
Reviewed by T&O registrar; decision to admit and list for ORIF
Transferred to trauma ward, bed 6
Ward nursing admission, risk assessments completed
Enoxaparin given
Anaesthetic review ahead of day-2 list
Evening review and limb observations
NBM commenced for theatre
Night observations and limb check
Trauma consultant ward round; confirmed for afternoon list
